gloss: to dream of; to fantasize about; to imagine idly

definitions.gloss: to dream of; to fantasize about; to imagine idly
definitions.explanation: To indulge in unrealistic or fanciful thoughts about something, often something unlikely or impractical.

examples.japanese: ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦{平和|へいわ}→平和：01507_heiwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{夢想|むそう}する。
{子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}、⟦{宇宙|うちゅう}{飛行士|ひこうし}→宇宙飛行士：28176_uchuuhikoushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{夢想|むそう}して⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: As a child, I used to fantasize about becoming an astronaut.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{遠|とお}い→遠い：00529_tooi⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{夢想|むそう}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: He is always gazing out the window, fantasizing about life in a faraway country.

notes:
A literary word that implies idle, unrealistic daydreaming or fantasizing. It often carries a slightly romantic or impractical nuance — the thing being dreamed of is typically distant, grand, or unlikely. The noun form ⟦{夢想|むそう}→夢想：21442_musou⟧ appears in compounds like {夢想家|むそうか} (dreamer, fantasist).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{夢想|むそう}→夢想：21442_musou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ふける→ふける：09960_fukeru⟧: to be lost in daydreams
- {夢想家|むそうか}: a dreamer; a fantasist
- ⟦{夢想|むそう}→夢想：21442_musou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧: a world of fantasy
- ⟦{壮大|そうだい}→壮大：10900_soudai⟧な⟦{夢想|むそう}→夢想：21442_musou⟧: a grand fantasy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to dream (while sleeping) — literal dreaming during sleep
- ⟦{空想|くうそう}する→空想する：19649_kuusousuru⟧: to daydream; to imagine — similar but more neutral; less literary than ⟦{夢想|むそう}→夢想：21442_musou⟧
- ⟦{妄想|もうそう}する→妄想する：21911_mousousuru⟧: to have delusions; to fantasize — carries a more negative connotation of irrational or obsessive fantasy
